messages:
tara: noticed the performance chart UX problems during the console pass. main things: legend reorders on toggle, axis units unclear, and smoothing hides spikes too easily :frowning:
alex: agree. current axis shows 'Duration (ms)' but ticks are 0,100,200 which reads oddly. either include unit on ticks (100 ms) or use compact suffixes for counts.
maria: accessibility: legend needs aria-labels like 'Series: api latency p95' and keyboard nav (tab to focus, space to toggle). also focus ring missing.
sam: propose these defaults: smoothing OFF for SLO/time-series, tick-suffix for rate metrics, unit-on-major-ticks for crowded charts. make it configurable per-metric-type.
josh: outliers: clipping to max compresses the visible range. option: clip + small inset histogram that shows tail; include a tiny chevron indicator where clip occurs. keeps main scale readable and shows outliers.
tara: legend behavior: don't reorder entries on toggle, instead dim hidden ones and keep order stable. this is less surprising and easier to scan.
alex: color contrast: grey series fails AA at 12px. bump to #6f767b or add pattern fills for color-blind teams.
maria: tooltip copy: be explicit, e.g., 'P50 latency: 42 ms' not just 'value'. include unit and stat.
sam: implementation snippet for tick suffixing: ```js
const tickFmt = (v, metric) => metric.type === 'rate' ? `${v} req/s` : metric.type==='time' ? `${v} ms` : `${v}`
```
josh: action items: @alex mock tick-suffix and major-tick rule, @maria add aria attrs + keyboard spec, @sam prototype smoothing toggle UI + default rules, @tara design inset histogram and clip indicator.
design-bot: Reminder: design review Tue 10am. Agenda: legend order, unit formatting, outlier inset.
tara: I'll upload updated frames before EOD and open a PR for early feedback. :thumbsup:
